KellyC Image Downloader

Batch download images from any site, filtered by size, proportions or URL. Many sites have auto-filters that pick the original image instead of the preview.

Credits

Created by nradiowave (NC22/KellyC-Image-Downloader). The original project was removed from the extension stores and its websites are offline.

This fork keeps it working in current Chrome and Firefox: TheElevatedOne/KC-Image-Downloader.
